title: Finite reduction estimate for an integral stratum source
statement: In the finite-field setting of [sk-def-sf-setting], let X be separated of finite type, and let a=i v:S->Z->X be an open immersion followed by a closed immersion, with quasi-compact open complement j:V->X. Let L be constructible with finite constant local model as in [det-lem-int-ext-formula]. Let c,s be natural numbers whose images in WithTop N are cd_l(j) and cd_l(S), respectively [sk-def-cd]. For any constructible integral sheaf N [sk-def-sfb-constructible], any n>=0, and any integer r>c+s+2, Hom(a_!L[0], integralReductionFunctor l E X (n+1)(N[0])[r]) is zero. These are actual derived quotient tensors [def-sfb-integral-derived-coefficient-data], with no torsion-freeness assumption.

source.place: paragraph (2): derived completeness and the three finite-reduction bullets

proof.text: The proved integral stratum Hom formula supplies the additive closed-support functor and its natural isomorphism from global internal Hom to sections of the dual tensor restricted support. The finite-field datum gives the required characteristic hypotheses. No target signature changes.

Apply integral_reduction_support_amplitude to the actual positive derived reduction. Its restricted support M has cohomology in [-1,c+1], with each cohomology sheaf classical and locally l-power torsion.

Let T be integralStratumDualTensor followed by integralStratumDerivedSections. The torsion heart sections theorem bounds T on each H^q(M)[0] in [0,s+1]. The proved bounded_heart_amplitude theorem extends this to T(M) in [-1,c+s+2]. In Lean the auxiliary heart class is the class of objects satisfying that image bound; it is closed under isomorphisms and contains zero by functoriality.

Since r>c+s+2, H^r(T(M)) vanishes. Commute the support/pullback/tensor/sections composite with shift and use H^0(K[r])=H^r(K). The Hom formula identifies this with H^0 of global internal Hom to the shifted reduction. Derived additive coyoneda for the regular module identifies that group with maps from its degree-zero complex. The existing singleFunctorObjUnitIso identifies this complex with the derived tensor unit; tensor-Hom adjunction and the right unitor identify its maps into internal Hom with the requested morphisms. Transport subsingleton along these equivalences.

proof_origin.note: Lean reduction via support amplitude and a heart-only dual sections bound, then bounded_heart_amplitude, the proved stratum Hom formula, and derived coyoneda evaluation.

theorem integral_stratum_reduction_ext_bound
    (D : WeilConjectures.FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    (S Z V : Scheme.{u}) (v : S ⟶ Z) (i : Z ⟶ X) (j : V ⟶ X)
    [IsOpenImmersion v] [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsOpenImmersion j]
    [CompactSpace S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] [QuasiCompact j]
    (hij : Set.range j = (Set.range i)ᶜ)
    (L : pulledBackModuleObjects (integralCoefficientRing l E) S)
    (hL : IsConstantModelConstructible (integralCoefficientRing l E) S L)
    (hmodel : HasFiniteConstantLocalModel (integralCoefficientRing l E) S L)
    (c s : ℕ)
    (hc : (c : WithTop ℕ) = relativeCohomologicalDimension l (Fact.out : l.Prime) j)
    (hs : (s : WithTop ℕ) = cohomologicalDimension l (Fact.out : l.Prime) S)
    (N : pulledBackModuleObjects (integralCoefficientRing l E) X)
    (hN : IsConstantModelConstructible (integralCoefficientRing l E) X N)
    (n : ℕ) (r : ℤ) (hr : (c : ℤ) + s + 2 < r) :
    Subsingleton (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
        ((lowerStar (integralCoefficientRing l E) i).obj
          ((openImmersionLowerShriek (integralCoefficientRing l E) v).obj L))) ⟶
      ((integralReductionFunctor l E X (n + 1)).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj N)) ⟦r⟧)
